SELECT "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_id, "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_name, SUM("jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders".order_total) AS revenue
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders"
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers" ON "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders".customer_id = "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_id
GROUP BY "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_id, "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
